config.content:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Example Commerce API
  version: 2.1.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.test/api/v2
paths:
  /users/me:
    get:
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Current authenticated user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/UserPublic"
  /users/{id}:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: include
        in: query
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      responses:
        "200":
          description: User by ID
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/UserPublic"
  /projects/{id}:
    get:
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Project summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ProjectSummary"
  /orders:
    post:
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Order created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  order_id:
                    type: string
                additionalProperties: false
  /graphql:
    servers:
      - url: https://api.example.test
    post:
      responses:
        "200":
          description: GraphQL execution result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: ["object", "null"]
                  errors:
                    type: array
components:
  schemas:
    BaseEntity:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        created_at:
          type: string
    UserPublic:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/BaseEntity"
        - type: object
          properties:
            username:
              type: string
            bio:
              type: ["string", "null"]
      unevaluatedProperties: false
    ProjectSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        title:
          type: string
      additionalProperties: false
